original:
रामसेतुसमं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति ।
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण ब्रह्महत्या व्यपोहति ॥
sanskrit:
रामसेतुसमं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति ।
यस्य दर्शनमात्रेण ब्रह्महत्या व्यपोहति ॥
transliteration:
rāmasetusamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā vyapohati ||
translation: There is no sacred pilgrimage sanctuary equal to Rama Setu, by the mere sight and remembrance of which the heaviest karmic burdens are purified.
meaning: Khanda 3: Brahma Khanda (Setu Mahatmya & Sacred Rameswaram)

layers.author: gv-tagare
layers.content: The Brahma Khanda centers upon the historical sanctification of Rameswaram and the bridge to Lanka, symbolizing the bridge of righteous action spanning worldly sorrow.

layers.author: kashi-scholars
layers.content: रामसेतु के समान कोई तीर्थ न हुआ है न होगा, जिसके दर्शन मात्र से घोर पापों का भी शमन हो जाता है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: रामसेतूसारखे पावन तीर्थ जगात कधीही झाले नाही आणि होणार नाही, ज्याच्या केवळ दर्शनाने सर्व पापांचे क्षालन होते.
